This plan expands attention around the most movable constraint while leaving the journal row intact. Its center is a board where one number rises and another flickers. The bank offers different distances and registers for rereading the same recorded material; it does not add a new day, memory, event, relationship, quest, or system.

## 3. Verified source record

The complete JSON entry below is copied from the current local source. Preserve its id, author_id, author_name, day, hour, knowledge_key, timestamp, and exact text. Candidate prose is editorial material, not part of the loaded row.

```json
{
  "id": "journal_raw_b3_27_general_the_reorder",
  "text": "The constraints reordered today. I did not reorder them. The reorder happened the way a season happens — not by decision but by the movement of the things themselves. The antibiotics are addressed. The fuel is counting down. The grow light is flickering. The flickering one is the one we can do something about. So the flickering one is the primary. I have learned that the primary constraint is not the most important one. It is the most movable one. The fuel is not movable. It is what it is. The antibiotics were movable and we moved them. The grow light is movable if the agri depot has bulbs. If it does not, the grow light becomes the fuel — a thing that is what it is. I told the Therapist this on Day 179. She said the body is kinder than the man. I am learning what she meant. The body responds to the number on the board. The number on the fuel board went up and I slept. The number on the grow light board is going down and I will not sleep tonight. The body is kinder because the body believes the number. The man knows the number is a story we tell ourselves about how long we have. The Therapist said I am two things — the body and the man. I am learning that the general is a third thing. The general is the one who decides which number to believe. Tonight the number is a flicker. Tomorrow the number is a walk. I will believe the walk because the walk is the thing I can do. The rest is the season.",
  "timestamp": "Day 189, 23h",
  "author_name": "The General",
  "author_id": "the_general",
  "knowledge_key": "general_constraints_reorder_flicker",
```
